headline_fact: On August 11, 2026, President Trump announced a further 90-day pause on raising the reciprocal tariff on Chinese goods to 125%; separately, a new 12.5% Section 301 tariff took effect July 24, 2026 over China's failure to enforce a forced-labor import ban, pushing the effective US tariff rate on many Chinese goods to close to 30% -- the highest of any country.
narration_script: President Trump announced on August 11, 2026 a pause of 90 days in increasing tariffs to 125% on Chinese goods. Additionally, a new 12.5% Section 301 tariff took effect July 24, 2026 for China's failure to enforce a forced-labor import ban, raising the US tariff rate on many Chinese goods close to 30%.
on_screen_text: US tariffs on Chinese goods now at ~30%; pause in higher tariffs announced.
